title: First chat question fails with "(internal)" when the model is slow; gateway gives up at 8 s
body:
Found while testing scripts/dev/full-local.sh under load: the first free-form web chat question failed with "We couldn't answer this time (internal)." No first token arrived within the 8 s deadline.

1. The chat shows an error code (machine talk). Replace with plain copy and keep the Try again action; add an oa-copy guard over every chat failure line.
2. Gateway: the last planned attempt should run to a longer per-class ceiling instead of failing at the first-token deadline (earlier attempts still fall back at ~8 s for chat, never after a first token); surface a still-working status to the chat; stub-adapter tests for slow-then-fast, all-slow-last-answers, all-fail.
